name: Tidal Council
subtitle: Threshold multisig
description: Example 8 — K-of-N multisig with EIP-712 EOA/ERC-1271 signatures or direct account approvals; signed execution uses one slot, approvals add slots.
long_description: A minimal threshold wallet for EOAs and EastSea v2 P-256 accounts. OpenZeppelin SignatureChecker verifies EOA signatures or calls a code-bearing owner's ERC-1271 isValidSignature. A relayer submits strictly ascending, unique owner addresses paired with signatures to executeWithSigners. Owners without off-chain message signing call approve from their account; the corresponding empty signature uses that approval, and signed/direct confirmations can be mixed without counting an owner twice. EIP-712 v2 binds the current chainId, contract address, destination, value, calldata, nonce and deadline. Deadline-free compatibility calls use the maximum uint256 deadline. The executed-hash ledger prevents replay. The owner set is static; direct approvals persist without a revocation API. Failed target calls revert the whole execution.

interface.description: Returns the constant marker value that identifies personal-test mode in the deploy policy.
Returns the EIP-712 type hash used for multisig transactions.
Returns whether the given owner has recorded an on-chain approval for the transaction hash.
Records the calling owner's on-chain approval of a transaction with no expiry; moves nothing itself but counts toward execution.
Records the calling owner's on-chain approval of a transaction with a deadline; moves nothing itself but counts toward execution.
Lets a registered token report a receipt so the personal-test token cap is checked; only callable by the token itself in personal-test mode.
Returns the current EIP-712 domain separator for this multisig and chain.
Returns the EIP-712 domain fields: name, version, chain id and verifying contract.
Runs the call (which may send native coin or call a token contract) once enough ascending owner signatures are supplied; anyone may submit, each hash runs once.
Runs the call once enough owner signers are given, using signatures or an empty entry for a prior approval, with no expiry; the call may move funds. Anyone may submit.
Runs the call before its deadline once enough owner signers are given, using signatures or an empty entry for a prior approval; the call may move funds. Anyone may submit.
Returns whether the transaction with this hash has already been executed.
Returns the EIP-712 hash of a transaction with no expiry that owners sign or approve.
Returns the EIP-712 hash of a transaction with the given deadline that owners sign or approve.
Returns the text 'personal-test' if this instance was deployed under a personal-test policy, otherwise 'testnet'.
Returns whether the address is an owner of this multisig.
Returns whether the given account is on the personal-test allow list for this instance.
Returns the policy authority address used to recognize allowed sibling instances, or zero outside personal-test mode.
Returns true if this instance was deployed in personal-test mode with access and value caps.
Returns the maximum native coin balance this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or 0 if disabled.
Returns the owner address of the personal-test policy, or zero if personal-test mode is off.
Returns the personal-test policy tuple: marker, owner address, native cap and token cap.
Returns the maximum token amount this instance may hold in personal-test mode, or 0 if disabled.
Adds or removes an account on the personal-test allow list; only the personal-test owner may call it and the owner cannot be removed.
Returns the number of owner confirmations required to execute.
